title: Vignette 2026-11-12: an essay as nested containers, wrapped for export

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-11-12, on the editor group's carried question (decision 42fcc319: can an essay container declare its comments and references as children while agents still file into them, srs-web#634): "But should we not simply have a bit of container nesting? (can  we nest a container?) An essay's pragraphs in one container. The comments in another. The references in another. And then we wrap all of these in an export?"

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-12; recorded verbatim. Concerns decision 42fcc319 (proposed, options A to D) and srs-web#634 (an essay is exported whole).
